observations: Photo 0 shows a red LPG gas cylinder in a car boot/trunk area.
Cylinder has a valve/regulator connection at the top (valve visible, regulator not clearly shown).
Cylinder body shows heavy surface rust/dirt and wear.
No clear readable brand/model/serial number on the cylinder in the photo.
No visible date stamp, inspection stamp, or cylinder certification markings are readable.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 does not show a readable capacity marking (e.g., 20kg) or scale/label that confirms the cylinder size.
Photo 0 shows wear/rust but does not prove origin (tokunbo vs locally used) or condition history.

risks.risk: Cylinder capacity (20kg) may be incorrect; wrong size affects market value and refill cost.
risks.proof: A clear close-up photo of the cylinder’s stamped capacity/serial plate (or any marking showing 20kg) plus the top valve area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as an unknown/possibly smaller or non-20kg cylinder (worst case for value).

risks.risk: Safety/condition risk due to visible heavy rust and wear; may be near end-of-life or fail inspection/leak test.
risks.proof: Video/clip of a full 360° inspection (including base and valve), and a leak test result (soap-bubble test) or a receipt from a gas plant/technician.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not guaranteed safe/needs servicing (worst case: treat as low-value used cylinder).

risks.risk: Valve/regulator compatibility and completeness not confirmed; missing parts or damaged valve can make it unusable.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the valve threads, safety cap (if any), and whether a regulator is included; show the connection point clearly.
risks.if_unproven: Price as cylinder only (no guaranteed regulator/parts).

risks.risk: Cylinder certification/inspection status unknown; may be expired and rejected for refill.
risks.proof: Clear photo of the inspection/certification stamp and date on the cylinder body (or neck ring).

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of any stamped markings showing capacity (20kg) and serial/ID.
Close-up of the valve area and threads; confirm whether regulator is included.
Full 360° video/clip showing the base, seams, and valve for damage/leaks.
Photo/receipt showing cylinder inspection date or leak test result.
response.reason: From the photo, the cylinder’s capacity and safety/inspection status are not verifiable, and those directly determine the correct Rivers market price. Request the stamped capacity/ID and inspection/leak-test proof before pricing.
